shared_elements: rows of small sign-like carved motifs (glyph-like elements)
justification: Both surfaces carry a human figure together with rows of small repeated sign-like carved marks and circular/disc motifs set within horizontal bands, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single frontal, massive, schematic figure whose body itself carries the ornaments (headdress, pectoral disc, belt-like bands), while B is a flat multi-figure narrative scene with a standing figure before a laden offering table, attendant figures and dense registers of inscription under an arched top: different composition, different relationships and different rendering conventions.
